decisions.reason: As the flagship product with its own page, the turnaround management software anchors the firm's push into airport digital solutions, and one year is too short to judge its results against aspiration, so the firm carries it rather than starting a search for other uses.
The connectivity module is a low-cost enabler that links the firm's apron hardware to its software suite, so dropping it would release few resources while weakening the integrated offering.

Billing software sits furthest from the firm's electrical equipment core and is only mentioned on the website, making it the most likely candidate for pruning, but with no clear evidence of a shortfall yet the firm keeps it for now.
Equipment monitoring builds directly on the firm's installed base of apron equipment and supports service revenue, so it fits the established business and is worth carrying.
The resource management module complements the turnaround software, and with results still uncertain the firm keeps it as part of the suite rather than cutting it after one year.
The safety alert service has modest visibility, but safety functions are valued by airport customers and maintaining it costs little, so the firm keeps it while results are uncertain.
